definitions.explanation: The measurement of a person's body from head to foot.

examples.japanese: {身長|しんちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How tall are you? / What is your height?

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{身長|しんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急|きゅう}に→急に：00263_kyuuni⟧⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
{身長|しんちょう}180⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We are looking for people over 180 cm tall.

notes:
{身長|しんちょう} is specifically for a person's height.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身長|しんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (to be tall)
- {身長|しんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (to be short)
- {身長|しんちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧ (to measure height)
- {身長|しんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧ (to grow taller)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {身長|しんちょう}: height of a person
- ⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧: height (colloquial, also means "back")
- ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧: height of objects

WATCH OUT:
{身長|しんちょう} (height) vs ⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧ (careful) - same reading, different meaning.
